description: Emails selected TuneWorks vehicle, setup, and session details to up to three recipients. Explicit user confirmation is required.

confirmed.description: True indicates that the user explicitly confirmed the recipient list and selected build details.

message.description: Optional message to include in the Share Build email.

recipients.description: Recipient email addresses. Share Build supports up to 3 recipients.

sessionIds.description: Optional TuneWorks session IDs to include.

setupIds.description: Optional TuneWorks setup IDs to include.

vehicleId.description: TuneWorks vehicle ID selected for Share Build.

name: send_share_build

outputSchema.description: Share Build send result or confirmation-required response for the external email action.

outcome.description: Optional domain outcome for an otherwise successful read.

status.description: Stable result status such as ok, created, updated, sent, auth_required, or confirmation_required.

tool.description: TuneWorks MCP tool name that produced this result.

title: Send Share Build
